author: BmB
body:
Hey i am quite annoyed that i have been banned for ban evading, when i was unbanned i assumed that i Radiqal's ban would be lifted as well, apparently not. I decided to leave it as i was contempt with being unbanned and i didn't use the account Radiqal much. I did ask Fluenza and Tel if i could be unbanned on the account and they said they could look into it. This was about a month back. Again i decided not to press. 


Now i have been banned for Ban Evading yet Radiqal should have been unbanned in the first place, i don't want this turning into a large thing but if i could please be unbanned on both accounts now and have this cleared up.

Hello,

Your wrong, once an account has been banned for ban evasion, it will stay banned. But, you should be able to play on your main, BmB. That infraction will be lifted.
